purpose: Verify Student Admin can create a club with the required club data.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is available.
Valid student coordinator and co-coordinator and a valid faculty councillor are available.
action_or_input: Submit a new club with a name, category, coordinator, co-coordinator, Club Faculty Councillor, and description.
expected_result: The system creates the club with the submitted data.

purpose: Verify club creation requires valid student leaders.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is available.
At least one selected coordinator or co-coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit a club creation request using the invalid student leader assignment.
expected_result: The system does not create the club.

purpose: Verify a Club Faculty Councillor assignment requires a valid faculty member.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is available.
The selected Club Faculty Councillor is not a valid faculty member.
action_or_input: Submit a club creation request with the invalid faculty assignment.
expected_result: The system does not create the club.

purpose: Verify club category is restricted to the specified values.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin and otherwise valid club data are available.
action_or_input: Submit a club creation request with a category other than Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
expected_result: The system does not create the club with the disallowed category.

purpose: Verify a newly created club is open pending Student Admin approval.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin and valid club data are available.
action_or_input: Create a new club.
expected_result: The new club is recorded with open status.

purpose: Verify Student Admin can approve an open club.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is available.
A club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Approve the open club.
expected_result: The club is recorded with confirmed status.

purpose: Verify the applicable Club Head can replace the coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
The club has current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
Valid replacement students are available.
action_or_input: Replace the club's coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
expected_result: The club's coordinator and co-coordinator assignments are replaced.

purpose: Verify replacement leadership assignments must refer to valid students.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
At least one proposed replacement is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the leadership change with the invalid replacement assignment.
expected_result: The system does not accept the invalid leadership assignment.

purpose: Verify a leadership change leaves only the current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments active.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
The club has current leadership assignments and valid replacements.
action_or_input: Change the club's coordinator and co-coordinator.
expected_result: Only the new current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments remain active for the club.

purpose: Verify a Club Head can book a session with the specified details.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A configured venue is available.
The requested time range is valid and has no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: Book a session with venue, date, start time, end time, description, and an optional poster.
expected_result: The session is successfully booked with the submitted details.

purpose: Verify a session or event is accepted only when its start time precedes its end time.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A configured venue is available.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event booking whose start time is equal to or later than its end time.
expected_result: The system does not accept the booking.

purpose: Verify overlapping bookings are prevented across sessions and events in the same venue and date.
preconditions: A session or event is already booked in a configured venue on a date.
The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event in the same venue and date with a time range that overlaps the existing booking.
expected_result: The system does not accept the overlapping booking.

purpose: Verify intended student recipients are notified after a session is booked.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A valid, conflict-free session booking and its intended student recipients are available.
action_or_input: Successfully book the session.
expected_result: The system notifies the intended student recipients of the new session.

purpose: Verify a Club Head can book an event with the specified details and faculty context.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A valid Club Faculty Councillor and configured venue are available.
The requested time range is valid and conflict-free.
action_or_input: Book an event with event details, Club Faculty Councillor information, venue, date, start time, end time, poster, and description.
expected_result: The event is successfully booked with the submitted details and faculty context.

purpose: Verify intended student recipients are notified after an event is booked.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A valid, conflict-free event booking and its intended student recipients are available.
action_or_input: Successfully book the event.
expected_result: The system notifies the intended student recipients of the new event.

purpose: Verify a student can apply to a confirmed club with an application description or achievements.
preconditions: A student is authenticated.
The target club has confirmed status.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application with a description or achievements.
expected_result: The system accepts the application.

purpose: Verify a student may maintain applications to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: A student is authenticated.
Two different clubs have confirmed status.
The student has no existing application to either club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to each of the two clubs.
expected_result: The system accepts applications to both different clubs.

purpose: Verify a student cannot submit a duplicate application to the same club.
preconditions: A student is authenticated.
The target club has confirmed status.
The student already has an application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: The system prevents the duplicate application.

purpose: Verify a new membership application is recorded as open.
preconditions: A student is authenticated.
The target club has confirmed status.
The student has no existing application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application.
expected_result: The application is recorded with open status.

purpose: Verify the applicable Club Head can access pending applications for the club.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
The club has at least one open membership application.
action_or_input: Request the pending membership applications for the applicable club.
expected_result: The system provides access to the club's pending membership applications.

purpose: Verify the applicable Club Head can approve an open membership application and optionally record remarks.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
An open membership application exists for the club.
action_or_input: Approve the open application and provide optional remarks.
expected_result: The system accepts the approval and records the optional remarks if supplied.

purpose: Verify an approved membership application changes from open to confirmed.
preconditions: An open membership application exists.
The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Approve the application.
expected_result: The application status changes from open to confirmed.

purpose: Verify a Club Head can create a poll with its expiration date, choices, and batch/branch target groups.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
Batch and branch target groups are available.
action_or_input: Create a poll with title, description, expiration date, choices, and selected batch and branch target groups.
expected_result: The system creates the poll with the submitted details and target groups.

purpose: Verify a voting poll requires at least two choices.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with fewer than two choices.
expected_result: The system does not accept the poll.

purpose: Verify poll creation notifies students in the selected target groups.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A valid poll and its selected target groups are available.
action_or_input: Create the poll.
expected_result: The system notifies students in the poll's selected target groups.

purpose: Verify an eligible targeted student can access an active poll and its choices.
preconditions: A student is authenticated and belongs to the poll's target groups.
The poll is active.
action_or_input: Request access to the poll.
expected_result: The student can access the active poll and its available choices.

purpose: Verify an eligible targeted student can cast one choice in an active poll.
preconditions: A student is authenticated and belongs to the poll's target groups.
The poll is active and has available choices.
action_or_input: Cast one choice in the poll.
expected_result: The system accepts the student's vote.

purpose: Verify a student cannot vote more than once in a poll and accepted votes are recorded in the tally.
preconditions: A student is authenticated and eligible for an active poll.
The student has already cast a vote in that poll.
action_or_input: Submit another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: The system prevents the additional vote; the accepted vote is recorded in the poll tally.

purpose: Verify a Club Head can submit a budget request with amount, purpose, description, and supporting file.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with a non-negative amount, purpose, description, and supporting file.
expected_result: The system accepts the budget request.

purpose: Verify a budget request is rejected for a negative amount or missing required supporting file.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a negative amount, or submit one without its required supporting file.
expected_result: The system rejects the invalid budget request.

purpose: Verify a submitted budget request is stored as open for tracking.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A valid budget request with supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit the budget request.
expected_result: The system stores the request as open for tracking; no online approval or rejection lifecycle is created.

purpose: Verify a Club Head can submit an event report with the specified details and report file.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
A report/details file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a report containing the club, student incharge, event name, event date/time, description, and report/details file.
expected_result: The system accepts and stores the submitted event report.

purpose: Verify an event report cannot be submitted without its required report/details file.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit an event report without the report/details file.
expected_result: The system does not accept the report.

source_id: AFR-GYM-034 councillor report access and review
purpose: Verify the assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review reports for the councillor's club.
preconditions: The assigned Club Faculty Councillor is authenticated.
A submitted event report exists for the assigned councillor's club.
action_or_input: Access and review the submitted event report.
expected_result: The system allows access and review of the report without creating an approval or rejection state.
